description: Copyable same-page JavaScript examples for automation agents using window.PolkaswapAgent.

examples.name: Load v1 agent and require node readiness
examples.goal: Start every runner from the ready event, then verify the public API version.

examples.name: Verify transient agent mode
examples.goal: Confirm the page was opened with the agent query flag before relying on modal-free automation.

examples.name: Connect an injected wallet account
examples.goal: Select a signer through the existing page wallet system.

examples.name: Resolve symbols once and execute with addresses
examples.goal: Avoid ambiguous symbols in repeated automated runs.

examples.name: Search common route assets
examples.goal: Discover likely route endpoints and optionally include balances.
examples.code:
const common = await agent.commonAssets({ query: 'xor', includeBalances: true });
const allMatches = await agent.assets({ query: 'pswap', includeBalances: true });

examples.name: Quote exact-input swap
examples.goal: Explore a route without preparing signer state.
examples.code:
const quote = await agent.quoteSwap({ assetIn, assetOut, amount: '1', side: 'input', dexId: 'best', quoteTimeoutMs: 15000 });
console.log(quote.quoteDigest, quote.amountIn, quote.amountOut, quote.minAmountOut);

examples.name: Plan autonomously without a wallet
examples.goal: Resolve, quote, and inspect public SDK-call metadata in one call. No prior quote, wallet permission, executable intent, or persisted authorization is required.

examples.name: Prepare then execute exact-input swap
examples.goal: Spend exactly the input amount and protect output with slippage. Execution passes only the prepared intent and idempotency key.

examples.name: Prepare then execute exact-output swap
examples.goal: Receive exactly the output amount and protect maximum input spend. Execution passes only the prepared intent and idempotency key.

examples.name: Assess swap against runner policy
examples.goal: Make an explicit no-signing approval decision before execution. Execution passes only the prepared intent and idempotency key.

examples.name: Prepare then execute transfer
examples.goal: Transfer through the same prepare, intent, and idempotency flow. Execution passes only the prepared intent and idempotency key.

examples.name: Prepare then execute add liquidity
examples.goal: Add liquidity without enabling pool creation by accident. Execution passes only the prepared intent and idempotency key.

examples.name: Prepare then execute remove liquidity by percent
examples.goal: Withdraw a position-relative LP amount. Execution passes only the prepared intent and idempotency key.

examples.name: Plan with max helpers
examples.goal: Read maximum executable amounts before building a prepare request.

examples.name: Recover before retrying
examples.goal: Avoid duplicate submissions after signing cancellation, browser crash, or uncertain handoff.

examples.name: Wait for a transaction
examples.goal: Poll local, indexer, or chain-backed status until the desired state is reached.
examples.code: const status = await agent.waitForTransaction({ txId: '0x...', lookup: 'any', status: 'finalized', timeoutMs: 60000 });

examples.name: Subscribe to local and indexer history
examples.goal: Receive local page updates and account-history indexer updates.

examples.name: Export portable state safely
examples.goal: Move idempotency state between browser profiles or produce redacted logs.

examples.name: Use optional browser client
examples.goal: Use a small same-page helper for prepare-and-execute flows.

examples.name: Map error code to runner action
examples.goal: Branch on stable error codes instead of localized text.
